title: phyla nodiflora var. pusilla
intro: Phyla nodiflora var. pusilla, commonly known as Mexican tea, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to Mexico and Central America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of P. nodiflora var. pusilla are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which are mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
